brief: Prioritise the unit for pre-event attention because its advanced age and loading history leave it with a reduced margin against mechanical failure under sustained heat exposure [MG-023]. Where a vegetation or obstruction defect is outstanding, clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity to restore the cooling margin [SOP-011]. Obstructed ventilation must be cleared rather than deferred, as clearance is low-cost and immediate [SOP-015].
